description: PaceTune visual layout definitions. Two types: 'photo_overlay' requires a user-uploaded photo. 'music_only' generates a standalone data visual with no photo. Updated v2: all layouts support multiple songs per split (2–3 songs per km is common).
multi_song_note: Splits frequently contain 2–3 songs. Every layout must handle this. The preferred approach per layout is defined in data_mapping.multi_song_strategy. Never collapse multiple songs into one line without visual distinction. Never drop songs to save space — reduce font size or restructure first.

photo_overlay_layouts.name: Side margin strip
photo_overlay_layouts.photo_requirement: Portrait or selfie with 18–22% horizontal negative space on one side.

composition.strip_side: auto — whichever side has more negative space
composition.strip_background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55) on light photos, rgba(255,255,255,0.85) on dark

data_mapping.middle: per-split rows: split number | pace | then song list below
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each song in the split gets its own sub-row, indented under the pace. Song title italic, artist muted below. If 3 songs, stack all 3 sub-rows. Strip height expands to fit — do not truncate songs.

photo_overlay_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every song in every split must appear. If strip is space-constrained, reduce font size before dropping any song. Artist name can be abbreviated to initials if needed.
avoid: Placing strip over the subject's face or body
Hard-coding a fixed row height — rows must expand for multi-song splits
Dropping songs from a split to save space

photo_overlay_layouts.name: Bottom ticker
photo_overlay_layouts.photo_requirement: Any photo. Best for wide or action shots.

composition.band_height_percent: 28–32 when splits have multiple songs, 24 for single-song splits
composition.photo_treatment: none — hard edge between band and photo

data_mapping.centre_zone: split cards inline. Each split card: pace (top) + stacked song list (below). Songs stack vertically within the card.
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each split is a card. Inside the card, songs stack vertically: song 1 title, song 2 title, song 3 title — all same small size. Card height grows. Separator between split cards is a thin vertical rule.

photo_overlay_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs in all splits must appear. Increase band height before truncating.
avoid: Collapsing multi-song splits to a single line
Capping band height — let it grow for multi-song splits
Applying scrim above the band

photo_overlay_layouts.name: Floating callouts
photo_overlay_layouts.photo_requirement: Photos with clear negative space zones. Falls back immediately if none.

composition.placement_logic: Labels placed only in detected negative space zones. No label on subject.

data_mapping.per_label: pace value (largest) | then song list stacked below
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each split label is a small stacked block: pace on top, then song 1, song 2, song 3 each on their own line. Font reduces as song count grows. 3-song splits use ~9px song text. Connecting hairline runs from label to an implied baseline.
data_mapping.grouping: Labels spread across available negative space

photo_overlay_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per split in the label. If the label becomes too tall for the zone, fall back to side_margin_strip.
avoid: Single-line song summaries like '3 songs'
Placing labels on the subject
Using on busy photos

photo_overlay_layouts.name: Strava-style card

composition.structure: stacked — photo header top, data panel below
composition.data_panel_height: scales with split count and song count per split

data_mapping.split_rows: Each split is a row group. Row group header: km N | pace. Below header: indented song rows — one per song. Artist name beside or below song title.
data_mapping.footer: total distance | avg pace | total time
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each split expands into a mini-group. Split header row (km + pace), then indented song rows below. Thin divider between split groups. This is the most readable layout for multi-song splits.

photo_overlay_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every song row must appear. This is the terminal fallback — it must always accommodate all data.
avoid: Treating a split with 3 songs as a single row
Decorative icons or app UI chrome
Fixed-height rows that can't expand

photo_overlay_layouts.name: Setlist tape
photo_overlay_layouts.photo_requirement: Any portrait photo. Best for casual selfies.

composition.structure: photo left 55%, setlist panel right 45% (or stacked on narrow formats)

data_mapping.song_list: Every song across all splits listed in run order. Numbered sequentially 01, 02, 03... — not grouped by split.
data_mapping.song_row: song title (bold left) | pace of that split (right, muted monospace) | artist below title
data_mapping.split_transition_marker: A subtle em-dash or thin rule between the last song of one split and the first of the next — like a setlist break between set halves.
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: All songs flattened into a single ordered list. Split identity is shown only by the pace annotation on the right — same pace value repeats for songs in the same split. This is intentional: it reads as a flowing setlist, not a data table.

photo_overlay_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every song must appear. This is the most song-complete layout by design.
avoid: Grouping songs by split with headers — defeats the setlist feel
Showing split numbers — the setlist is about songs, not km markers
Bright saturated colours

music_only_layouts.name: Running track
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Bird's-eye oval running track. Each concentric lane = one split. Outermost lane = split 1. Lane colour is distinct per split.

data_mapping.off_lane_callouts: song callouts outside the oval — one callout per song in the split, stacked vertically as a small list
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each lane has a callout bracket outside the oval. The bracket lists all songs for that split stacked vertically: song 1, song 2, song 3. A thin line connects the bracket to the lane. If songs are long, abbreviate to first 20 chars.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per lane must appear in the callout. If callout area is crowded, reduce song title font size — never drop a song.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: top-down oval running track, dark background.
Lanes: one per split, outermost = split 1. Distinct colour per lane.
On each lane: pace value.
Outside oval for each lane: a small stacked song list (all songs for that split), connected by a thin line to the lane edge.
Centre oval: total distance + total time.
Style: clean geometric, flat, no 3D.
avoid: More than 8 splits
Single song label when the split has multiple songs
3D perspective

music_only_layouts.name: Vinyl disc
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Vinyl record from above. Disc divided into pie segments — one per split. Concentric groove rings overlaid. Centre label = run totals.

data_mapping.inside_segment: pace value (large) + first song title (small). If multiple songs: stack song titles or use 'Song 1 / Song 2' separator.
data_mapping.outer_ring_legend: If songs don't fit inside wedges, add a legend ring just outside the disc — split colour dot + full song list per split.
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Primary: stack up to 2 song titles inside the wedge at small font size. If 3 songs or wedge is too narrow: show pace + song count inside (e.g. '3 songs'), full list in outer legend ring.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs must appear — either inside the wedge or in the outer legend. Never just show a count.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: vinyl record top-down, dark background.
Disc divided into N segments proportional to split time.
Each segment: distinct colour, pace (large), song titles stacked (small).
If segment too narrow for text: outer legend ring shows split colour + song list.
Groove rings: faint concentric lines over all segments.
Centre circle: run name + distance.
Style: flat, no 3D or gloss.
avoid: Showing only the first song when there are multiple
Glossy or 3D effects
Equal segments when split times vary significantly

music_only_layouts.name: Waveform timeline
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Stylised audio waveform across full width. Colour-coded sections per split. Bar height encodes pace.

data_mapping.section_label_zone: below each section: stacked song list for that split
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Below each waveform section, a stacked song column: song 1 (top, most prominent), song 2, song 3 — each on its own line, same split colour, decreasing opacity for each subsequent song. Pace value above the song list.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every song in every section must appear in the label zone below it.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: audio waveform, dark background, full width.
N colour-coded sections by split. Bar height = inverse pace.
Below each section: pace value then stacked song list (all songs for that split, one per line).
Section dividers: thin vertical rules.
Header: run name + distance.
Style: music player aesthetic, flat bars.
avoid: Collapsing multi-song splits to a single song title
More than 6 splits
All bars the same height

music_only_layouts.name: Cassette tape
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Top-down flat cassette illustration. Tape between reels is colour-segmented by split. Cassette body is the label area.

data_mapping.tape_band: N colour sections proportional to split distance
data_mapping.tape_section_label: song title(s) for that split — tiny text on or above the band
data_mapping.cassette_body: run name, date, total distance, avg pace
data_mapping.side_list: full numbered song list printed on the cassette body sides or below, one per line — all songs across all splits in run order
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: The tape band is too narrow for multiple song titles. Primary label on the band is the pace value only. Full song list is placed on the cassette body as a printed track listing: A SIDE / B SIDE split at the halfway point of the run, numbered tracks.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs appear in the body track listing. Tape band shows pace only when songs won't fit.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: flat top-down cassette illustration.
Tape window: segmented by split (colour per split, proportional to distance).
On tape segment: pace value only (songs listed on body instead).
Cassette body: printed track listing, A SIDE up to halfway, B SIDE after — all songs in run order, numbered.
Body also shows: run name, date, total stats.
Style: flat, illustrative, not photorealistic.
avoid: Trying to fit multiple song titles on the tape band — too narrow
Photorealistic rendering
Losing the cassette shape identity

music_only_layouts.name: Gig poster
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: The run as a concert. Typographic poster — no illustration. Songs are the setlist.

data_mapping.headline: run name or total distance
data_mapping.song_list: every song in run order, numbered sequentially
data_mapping.song_row: song title (bold) + artist (smaller below) + pace of that split (right margin)
data_mapping.split_marker: where the km changes, a faint horizontal rule with 'km 2' in tiny type in the margin — unobtrusive but present
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: All songs flattened into a single numbered setlist. The km marker appears between songs at split boundaries. Same pace value is repeated in the right margin for songs in the same split — this is intentional and shows which songs belonged to the same km.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every single song must appear. This layout is the most song-complete by design.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: typographic concert poster, cream/white background.
Headline: run name or distance.
Setlist: all songs in run order, numbered 01 02 03...
Each song: title (bold condensed) + artist (smaller) + pace in right margin.
Between songs at split boundaries: a faint rule with 'km N' annotation.
Footer: total distance + run time.
Style: gig poster, no illustration, one accent colour for headline only.
avoid: Grouping songs into split blocks with headers — ruins the setlist feel
Multiple accent colours
Making it look like an app

music_only_layouts.name: Pace equalizer
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Vertical equalizer bars — one per split. Height = pace. Song titles in/below bars.

data_mapping.bar_height: inverse pace in seconds — faster = taller
data_mapping.inside_bar: song titles stacked vertically inside bar (rotated 90°) if bar is tall enough
data_mapping.below_bar: pace value + km N + song list if didn't fit inside
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: If bar is tall enough: stack all song titles vertically inside, rotated 90°, each in a slightly different shade of the split colour. If bar is short: song titles stack below the bar in the label zone, same split colour. Never merge multiple songs into one label.
data_mapping.bar_height_formula: seconds = min*60 + sec. fastest = min(all). height = 30 + ((fastest/split_seconds) * 70). Min height 25px.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per split visible — either inside the bar or below it in the label zone.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: vertical equalizer bars, dark background, one per split.
Bar height = inverse pace (faster = taller).
Inside each bar: all songs for that split stacked vertically (rotated 90°), each song its own line.
If bar too short: songs stack below the bar in label zone.
Below each bar: pace value (bold) + km N.
Header: run name or date.
Style: flat fills, clean.
avoid: Runs with all equal paces
More than 8 splits
Showing only the first song per split

music_only_layouts.name: Album shelf
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Record sleeves or book spines on a shelf. One spine per split. Height = split time. Song titles on the spine.

data_mapping.on_spine_vertical: pace value at bottom + song titles stacked above
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: All songs for the split are printed vertically on the spine, one above the other. Font size reduces as song count increases — 3 songs use a smaller size than 1 song. If the spine is too narrow for stacked vertical text, songs are listed on a small pull-tab label hanging off the top of the spine.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs for each split on its spine. Pull-tab label as fallback if spine is too narrow.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: record spines on a shelf, dark wood background.
One spine per split, height proportional to split time.
Each spine: distinct colour, song titles stacked vertically on the spine, pace at base.
If multiple songs: all stacked vertically, smaller font.
Shelf base: single horizontal rule.
Footer: run name + distance.
Style: flat, illustrative.
avoid: More than 8 splits
Showing only the first song on a multi-song spine
Making spines all the same height

music_only_layouts.name: Tour map
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Abstract map with split stops as tour cities. Dashed route connects them.

data_mapping.stop_label: pace + km number below pin. Song list above pin.
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Above each stop pin: a small stacked list of all songs for that split. Each song on its own line. Font scales down for 3-song stops. The song list is the main label — the pin is the anchor.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per stop in the label above the pin.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: abstract tour poster map, cream background.
N stop pins on an implied route, dashed connecting line.
Above each pin: stacked song list for that split (all songs).
Below each pin: pace + km N.
Header: run name as tour headline.
Footer: date + total distance.
Style: illustrated map, flat.
avoid: Real map backgrounds
More than 8 stops
Single song label on multi-song stops

music_only_layouts.name: Subway line
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Transit map. Each split is a station. Track colour changes per split. Labels alternate above/below.

data_mapping.station_label: song list for that split + pace
data_mapping.label_position: alternating above and below the line
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each station label is a small stacked list: pace (top, bold) then each song on its own line below. Labels alternate sides. For 3-song stations, the label is taller — the line accommodates this by having enough vertical space between the track and the canvas edge.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per station in the station label.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: abstract transit map, dark background.
Single curved line, track colour changes per split.
N station stops (circle markers).
Station labels alternate above/below: pace (bold) then all songs stacked.
Line start: total distance. Line end: run time.
Style: clean transit map, flat.
avoid: Real subway map styles — keep it abstract
Collapsing multi-song stations to a single song
More than 8 stops

music_only_layouts.name: Pace spiral
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Archimedean spiral, colour-coded per split. Callouts at split boundaries. Centre = total distance.

data_mapping.split_callout: at the start of each split: song list + pace as a small stacked label with a hairline to the spiral
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Each callout is a small stacked block: pace on top, then song 1, song 2, song 3 — each on its own line, set small. Callout placed in the nearest open space around the spiral. Hairline connects callout to the split's start point on the spiral.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per split in their callout label.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: Archimedean spiral, dark background, 1.5–2 turns.
Spiral line changes colour at each split boundary.
At each split start: a callout label (pace + all songs stacked) connected by a hairline.
Centre circle: total distance.
Outer end: run end time.
Style: precise, data-art, no fills.
avoid: Only 2 splits — too few turns
Showing a single song when split has multiple
Overlapping callout labels — space them radially

music_only_layouts.name: Run clock
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Analogue clock face. Arc segments = splits. Clock hands = start and end time.

data_mapping.arc_segment: one per split, proportional to split time
data_mapping.outer_arc_label: song list just outside the disc edge, one per segment
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Inside the arc: pace only (not enough room for multiple songs). Outside the disc edge, adjacent to each arc segment: a small stacked song list for that split. The list is positioned at the midpoint of each arc, radiating outward. For 3-song splits, the external list is 3 lines tall.

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: All songs per segment in the external label adjacent to that arc.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: analogue clock face, dark background.
Clock divided into N arc segments (proportional to split time), distinct colours.
Inside each arc: pace value only.
Just outside the disc edge, at each arc's midpoint: stacked song list for that split.
Two clock hands: start time + end time.
Centre: run name + distance.
Style: watchface illustration, flat, minimal.
avoid: Trying to fit song titles inside narrow arc segments
Smartwatch UI aesthetic — keep it illustrative
Omitting outer song labels to keep it clean

music_only_layouts.name: Mixtape player
music_only_layouts.ideal_split_count: any — best for high split + high song counts
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Fictional music player poster. Run = playlist. Every song = a track row. Pace is the track duration.

data_mapping.track_row: song title (bold) + artist (small below) + pace of that split (right, monospace) + split colour accent strip on left
data_mapping.split_identity: all songs in the same split share the same left accent strip colour — visually groups them without needing headers
data_mapping.split_group_rule: thin full-width divider between the last song of one split and the first of the next
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: This is the native layout for multi-song splits. Every song is its own row. Songs from the same split share a colour accent — that's how the split grouping is shown. No nested structure needed.
data_mapping.progress_bar: shows total run time with elapsed proportion filled
data_mapping.header: run name + total distance + theme accent colour

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every single song must be a row. This layout scales to any number of songs.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: fictional music player poster, dark background.
Header bar: run name + total distance + accent colour.
Track list: every song as its own row.
Each row: coloured accent strip (left, same colour per split group) + song title (bold) + artist (small) + pace (right, monospace).
Thin divider between split groups.
Progress bar below track list + timestamps.
Style: editorial music player, not a literal app screenshot.
avoid: Grouping songs under split header rows — rows only, colour grouping is enough
Literal Spotify/Apple Music styling
Fixed row heights that can't show artist names

music_only_layouts.name: Star map
music_only_layouts.visual_concept: Night sky constellation. Each split = a bright star (or cluster of stars). Faint constellation lines connect splits in order.

data_mapping.split_star: one prominent star per split. Star size encodes pace — faster = slightly larger.
data_mapping.star_label: pace value + all songs for that split as a stacked callout adjacent to the star
data_mapping.multi_song_strategy: Multi-song splits become a small tight cluster of 2–3 stars instead of one star. Each star in the cluster represents a song. The cluster has one pace callout and individual song title labels beside each star. Constellation lines connect cluster centres, not individual song stars.
data_mapping.background_stars: scattered faint small stars for atmosphere

music_only_layouts.song_completeness_rule: Every song either has its own star (cluster approach) or appears in the split callout list.
music_only_layouts.prompt_fragment:
Visual: night sky, very dark background.
N split stars in distinct colours — size encodes pace.
For multi-song splits: a small cluster of stars (one per song) with individual song labels.
Faint constellation lines connecting splits in run order.
Each split: pace callout + all song titles adjacent.
Background: scattered faint stars.
Footer: run name + date + distance.
Style: flat celestial chart, no glow.
avoid: More than 8 split stars — sky becomes cluttered
Single star for multi-song splits with only one song label
Glow or blur effects
